sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned Aga for the State.

2. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by applicants for quashing the
summoning order dated 11.05.2022 and non-bailable warrant dated 18.03.2023 in Complaint Case
No. 2106 of 2020 (Smt. Sarita Vs. Vipin @ Shrikant an others) under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506
I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Rasulpur, District Firozabad, pending in the court of
Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, District Firozabad.
3.

After some argument, learned counsel for the applicants states that he may be permitted to withdraw this application filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. with liberty to file bail application before the court below.
4. Learned AGA has no objection to the prayer made by learned counsel for the applicants.
5. Under the circumstances, the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to applicants to approach the court concerned for bail.
